name: product-cycle
description: Product-discovery state machine, run as one hypothesis at a time: idle -> scoping -> researching -> hypothesis-registered -> measuring -> decided. The metric, threshold, and decision rule are pre-registered before data collection; hypothesis-registered -> measuring is refused unless all three fields are filled AND an approval token minted from the user's own turn (capture-approval.sh) is present; once measuring starts, edits to the threshold field are refused; decided is reached only by mechanically applying the registered rule.
